Definition: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings
BiblicalUsage: Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"; 1) the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah; 2) the son of Hazael, also king of Syria
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
